title: Electronic apparatus and anomaly detection method thereof

pse.problem: The invention aims to solve the limitation of performing anomaly detection on electronic devices without an efficient method for aggregating learning weights and optimizing hypersphere parameters in a federated learning environment.
pse.solution_function: The system performs semi-supervised anomaly detection using a modified FedAvg algorithm. It updates global learning parameters (global learning weight, center of a global hypersphere, and radius of the global hypersphere) based on learning parameters from multiple local models (one per terminal). The system then transmits the updated global model parameters back to the terminals.
pse.solution_structure: The system consists of central server, which aggregates and updates global model parameters, and multiple terminals, each with a local model that learns using its own data. The global hypersphere classifier is a key component used for anomaly detection.
pse.solution_implementation: During inference, the hypersphere-based classifier maps data into a latent space and calculates the distance between each data point's latent vector and the center of the global hypersphere. If the distance is greater than a certain threshold (radius), the data is considered anomalous.
pse.effect: The system allows for efficient anomaly detection in a federated learning environment, improving resource utilization and privacy protection by minimizing data exchanges.
